source_row.falsifier: False if yield jump is growth-positive and breadth recovers within 5 trading days.

source_row.formula: up_pct_5d >= 58% AND ret_5d between 0% and 1.25% AND disp_5d < p75
source_row.falsifier: False if broad positive breadth fails to convert into 3%+ equal-weight rise in next 15 trading days.

source_row.formula: prev_tail_down3_5d >= p90 AND current up_pct >= 68% AND ew_ret >= 1.25%
source_row.falsifier: False if reclaim day is sold below washout low within 5 trading days.

source_row.formula: tail_up3_3d - tail_down3_3d flips from negative to positive after ret_10d < p25
source_row.falsifier: False if asymmetry flip occurs without positive follow-through over next 10 trading days.

source_row.name: Compression Release Without Panic
